```{r}
# Load the processed clinical data created
# in the clinical-analysis file.

clinical <- readRDS(
  "analysis_data/BRCA_clinical_processed.rds"
)

colnames(clinical)

table(
  clinical$node_group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)
```
Keep patients with known nodal status.
```{r}
# Keep patients who were classified as either node-negative or node-positive.

node_mask <- !is.na(clinical$node_group)
clinical <- clinical[node_mask,]

clinical$node_group <- droplevels(clinical$node_group)

# Confirm the final group sizes.
table(clinical$node_group)
```

Load the MAF data
```{r}
gdc_directory <- file.path(
  currDir,
  "GDCdata"
)

gdc_directory
getwd()

maf_query <- GDCquery(
  project = "TCGA-BRCA",
  data.category = "Simple Nucleotide Variation",
  access = "open",
  data.type = "Masked Somatic Mutation",
  workflow.type = "Aliquot Ensemble Somatic Variant Merging and Masking"
)

# Repeat the download using smaller chunks. Existing correctly downloaded files should not need to be downloaded again.

GDCdownload(
  query = maf_query,
  directory = gdc_directory,
  method = "api",
  files.per.chunk = 10
)

maf <- GDCprepare(
  query = maf_query,
  directory = gdc_directory
)

# Save the prepared object so it can be loaded
# without downloading it again.

saveRDS(maf, "analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds")
```

Create the MAF object. 
```{r}

# Load previously downloaded mutation data

maf <- readRDS(
  "analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds"
)

# saving the prepared object so we don't have to download it each time
saveRDS(
  maf,
  "analysis_data/BRCA_mutations.rds"
)

# Combine the mutation data with the processed clinical information.

maf_object <- read.maf(
  maf = maf,
  clinicalData = clinical,
  isTCGA = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
# patient barcodes for node-negative tumors

node_negative_barcodes <-
  maf_object@clinical.data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[
    maf_object@clinical.data$node_group == "Node Negative"]


# patient barcodes for node-positive tumors

node_positive_barcodes <-
  maf_object@clinical.data$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[
    maf_object@clinical.data$node_group == "Node Positive"]


# MAF object w/ only node-negative tumors

node_negative_maf <- subsetMaf(
  maf = maf_object,
  tsb = node_negative_barcodes)


# MAF object w/ only node-positive tumors

node_positive_maf <- subsetMaf(
  maf = maf_object,
  tsb = node_positive_barcodes)
```
